comments: Possibly an interpreter of Dharmakīrti, as his name appears three times, along with the name of Dharmottara (ID:3780), to identify the proponent of a view in his commentary on the Pramāṇaviniścaya (ID:3774). These proponents are usually Indian commentators, with the exception of "lo tswa ba" (rNgog blo ldan shes rab (ID:3786)).
name: sgros
